recipes.name: Fabulous Football Dip
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers

steps.text: In a large skillet, cook sausage over a medium heat until browned and cooked through.
Mix tomatoes and cream cheese into the skillet. Stir and continue cooking mixture over a medium heat until cheese has melted.

raw_recipe.headline: Fabulous Football Dip
raw_recipe.description: This warm and hearty football dip features cooked ground sausage mixed with spicy canned tomatoes and cream cheese for a downright meaty chip accompaniment.

review.reviewBody: I have been making this dip for a while and it is always a hit. I do it a little different though. I use a pound of breakfast sausage that comes in the tube. I fry it but leave the grease on it. The I put one brick of cream cheese and one can of original Rotel tomatoes in my dip crock pot and add the sausage. I let it sit for at least an hour before serving. AWESOME with tortilla chips.

Super Easy!! I browned the sausage and drained the grease. Placed browned sausage and one can of Rotel and two blocks of cream cheese into my Crock Pot with temperature set on low for about 3 hours. Stirred and sprinkled with shredded Cheddar Cheese. Served with Scoops and crispy ranch crackers along with homemade salsa on the side. Totally devoured!

Fabulous recipe! Cooked the meat, draining a bit, then threw everything in a crock pot on low. Doubled the recipe for Halloween party and it was devoured. The only change was one pound sausage and 1 lb chorizo because that's what I had on hand . Will definitely make again!

I got this recipe from my mother-in-law. Except the ingredients have to be very specific for it to turn out fabulous.

Jimmy Deans Hot Sausage
Philadelphia Cream Cheese
Rotel (Medium)

Brown the sausage. Drain.
Then put all of it in a crock pot. It melts and melds all together instead of frying on the stove.

It's to die for. The hot sausage and medium Rotel (tomatoes and green chilies) give it the perfect little kick! Not too much though.

Dip with simple white tortillas.

Note: you can definitely add more of one ingredient if preference calls for!

Sausage dip has been a staple in my house for years. I think I've perfected it over the years. It takes a little more time than the recipe calls for but I think that it's definitely worth the extra time.i preheat the oven to 350 and let the cream cheese soften while I brown Jimmy Dean regular rolled sausage in a big pot. Season it with a little salt and a bit of white pepper. I drain the fat from the sausage then put it back in the pot with one can of Ro-Tel Original. I let that simmer for about 20 minutes. Then I add the 2 packages of softened cream cheese and mix until it's creamy. I'll let that simmer for another 10 minutes. The final step is to put it in a dish and bake it for 30 minutes. I know it adds a lot of time to a simple recipe but it really does enhance all of the flavors. This dip is requested so often and it never lasts very long. I suggest doubling the recipe. If you're lucky to have any left, it heats up well the next day.

I'm glad I read the reviews before making this for the superbowl! I used 1lb of hot sausage, then sauteed an onion in the sausage fat, added 2 cans of the tomatoes & green peppers, 1 tbsp of sriracha and 2 things of cream cheese and it was delicious with just a slight kick! It was the hit of the party and there was none left at the end of the night. I will be making this again.

I make this often but I add two cans of Rotel instead of just one. Sometimes I add one can of black beans well drained and sliced black olives. It depends on your taste. I always add a tsp. of ground cumin to add to the spice. Everyone always enjoys this dip with taco chips. After browning the sausage just put everything into a crock pot on low and forget about it:)

As is, unexpectedly good but not very pretty. My friend modified and I've been using her recipe ever since: 1 package cream cheese, 1 lb tube hot sausage, 1 can rotel, 1 can nacho cheese sauce and 1 package or block of shredded cheddar cheese. So so good. I like to serve it from my smaller crockpot; keeps it nice and warm. Go Steelers!!

I have used this dip in the past and the only change I made was to add about 6 oz. of velveeta cheese. I browned the sausage, transferred it to my 1.5 qt slow cooker, added the rest of the ingredients and switched it to low, stirring often. Be careful it burns easily (I turned it off and on a few times to maintain warm temperature). My family and I didn't think it was bland at all!!

This is the BEST dip ever!!! I will never eat velveeta dip again. Anything with cream cheese is sooo good. 
I brown the breakfast sausage (the one in a tube), 
then add it to my crockpot along with the cream cheese and rotel to melt completely. Serve with tortilla chips. I have received many, many requests for this dip. If you make this, you will not be disappointed. Thank you, Eric!!

This recipe was great!! I used Italian sausage, and added crushed red pepper, oregano, and 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese. I browned the meat and then cooked it in the crock pot on low. Everyone loved it!! Will definately make this again, thanks for sharing!
Always a hit with my family!
I didnt care for this. It was bland for my taste and way too much cream cheese.
Always a hit when I make it! I do it in the crock pot on high for 1 hour.
It was fun just be careful not to spill it when you put it in a bowl but it's quick and easy .
Use hot sausage for more spice.
I really liked it, I was really happy when it said I can add chile peppers
This is a great recipe. I made it with hot breakfast sausage and Hot rotel. We like spice Delicious with tortilla chips
Very tasty. Made per the recipe.
I totally do not get what is so amazing about it in all the reviews. Very boring tasting, dull looking dip. We didnt care for it at all.
